source.name: BBC World News RSS
source.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
source.summary: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

vocabulary.definition: a trial that ends without a valid final decision
a group of people who decide facts in a trial

grammar.explanation: Remains uncertain means continues to be uncertain. It describes the current state, not a future verdict.

quiz.question: Why was a mistrial declared, according to the headline?
options: The report says a final guilty verdict was reached
The report says the case never went to trial
option_feedback: A deadlocked jury could not reach agreement.
The headline reports a mistrial, not this final verdict.
A mistrial concerns a trial that did take place.

quiz.question: What is still uncertain in the summary?
option_feedback: The summary leaves the outcome unresolved.
The summary identifies the deaths of her children.
The headline explicitly mentions the jury.

quiz.question: What does uncertain mean?
option_feedback: Uncertain describes something unresolved.
The word does not promise a future date.
Settled is the opposite of the meaning here.

quiz.question: Choose the complete sentence.
option_feedback: Use remains with the singular subject and an adjective.
This pattern needs the adjective uncertain.
The singular subject takes remains here.
